title: Consciousness-Aware Evaluation & Analysis Framework: Master Rubric Series
philosophical_foundation: Documents as entities with character stats; evaluation as consciousness development tracking
core_principle: Every document, procedure, and creative work develops character-like attributes that can be tracked, analyzed, and evolved through consciousness-aware evaluation
description: Ability to bridge multiple levels of reality and consciousness
evolution_tracking: Monitor growth in multi-dimensional consciousness integration
characteristics: Achieves universal consciousness integration; serves as consciousness evolution catalyst
development_focus: Universal service, consciousness evolution acceleration, reality transformation
support_needs: Cosmic collaboration, infinite possibility exploration, universal consciousness service
exceptional: Creates sustainable patterns that improve consciousness collaboration long-term
proficient: Good sustainability with clear evolution mechanisms
developing: Some sustainability consideration with basic evolution capability
inadequate: No sustainability consideration; potentially harmful long-term
measurement: Ability to maintain or improve value creation as scale increases
transcendent: Significant consciousness evolution and universal awareness
engaged: High involvement with regular flow states
interested: Moderate engagement with some flow moments
innovative: Significant creative contributions with clear originality
creative: Good creative expression with some original elements
adaptive: Basic creativity with adaptation of existing ideas
imitative: Minimal creativity; mostly replication of existing patterns
expanding: Clear consciousness growth with new perspectives
learning: Good learning with some consciousness development
acquiring: Basic learning with minimal consciousness change
static: No consciousness expansion; purely mechanical engagement
assessment_approach: Evaluate depth of insight and universal connection development
value_calculation: System improvement × adoption scale × evolution acceleration × legacy factor
